## 更新内容

使用 deew 的音频任务现要求 **deew 5.5.3 或更新版本**和授权 DEE ≥6.7.0。升级时替换 CLI 版 `deew.exe`，可保留原有 `config.toml` 和完整的 DEE 目录。建议搭配 truehdd ≥0.6.3、dee_shim ≥0.2.0。[下载 deew 5.5.3](https://github.com/pcrlnd/deew/releases/tag/5.5.3)

- 适配 deew 5.5.3 音频选项：新增 `ac4-ims` 与 `--ac4-ims-mode`（`general`/`music`，按需校验 `dee_ac4ims_encoder` 与 `truehdd`）；支持 `-sps`/`-lpf`/`-s3a`、`-wm`/`--warp-mode`、`-bc`/`--bed-conform` 与单次管道覆盖 `-p`/`--pipe`；兼容旧配置中的 `-nps`/`--no-phase-shift`，并在编辑 `config.toml` 时保留新增字段。
- 支持 deew 5.5 输出命名规则（`-on`/`--output-name`、`-ot`/`--output-template` 及 `[output].template`），结合 `ffprobe` 读取音轨语言和标题标签，用于桌面输出预览、覆盖确认与 MCP 计划校验。
- 解复用页支持通过 `eac3to` 提取 MKV 轨道：选择包含 `.mkv` 的目录时，自动识别蓝光目录或 MKV 目录；目录内有单个 MKV 时自动加载轨道，多个 MKV 时在左侧列表按自然顺序列出，选中后按需扫描。视频和音频自动匹配原始扩展名，SRT/ASS/SSA/PGS 字幕使用对应扩展名导出；`eac3to` 未返回 MKV 章节时，通过 `ffprobe` 探测并导出为 UTF-8 OGG 章节 `.txt`。`DGDemux` 仍仅支持蓝光目录。
- 修复 `eac3to` 控制台按系统 ANSI 代码页（如中文 Windows 下的 GBK）输出时中文轨道标题与路径乱码的问题。
- 修复 `eac3to` 扫描蓝光目录时的播放列表解析：正确处理输出中的回车和退格控制字符，兼容带多段 `.m2ts`、视角标注和跨行章节汇总的列表格式；带 `-minDuration=0` 未返回播放列表时自动回退重试。

### 视觉更新

- 修复 `deew 5.5.2+` 管道编码和 Atmos 只测量阶段的进度条跳变与停顿，按实际执行阶段连续分配进度，并在收到 `percent: null` 脉冲事件时保留已显示的进度。

deew 5.5.3 的短样本编码与响度测量已通过验证，96 kHz TrueHD 解码后的 PCM 与源 PCM 逐字节一致，详见 [验收记录](https://github.com/frankie1024/FlowEncode/blob/v3.0.5/docs/DEEW553-VALIDATION.md)；`eac3to` MKV 解复用、中文轨道标题解码、MKV 章节导出与蓝光目录扫描已通过本地实测和回归测试。真实 TrueHD Atmos 测量、Atmos 编码以及 `-wm`/`-bc` 在真实 Atmos 素材上的解码结果仍待素材验收。

提供 Windows x64 安装包、便携 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

## Update Notes

Audio tasks that use deew now require **deew 5.5.3 or newer** and licensed DEE ≥6.7.0. To upgrade, replace the CLI `deew.exe`. You can keep your existing `config.toml` and complete DEE folder. truehdd ≥0.6.3 and dee_shim ≥0.2.0 are recommended. [Download deew 5.5.3](https://github.com/pcrlnd/deew/releases/tag/5.5.3)

- Add support for deew 5.5.3 audio options: add `ac4-ims` and `--ac4-ims-mode` (`general`/`music`, checking `dee_ac4ims_encoder` and `truehdd` as needed); support `-sps`/`-lpf`/`-s3a`, `-wm`/`--warp-mode`, `-bc`/`--bed-conform`, and per-run pipe overrides via `-p`/`--pipe`; keep compatibility with legacy `-nps`/`--no-phase-shift` settings and preserve the new fields when editing `config.toml`.
- Implement deew 5.5 output naming (`-on`/`--output-name`, `-ot`/`--output-template`, and `[output].template`) using track language and title tags read by `ffprobe` for desktop output previews, overwrite checks, and MCP execution plans.
- Support MKV track extraction through `eac3to` on the Demux page: selecting a folder automatically detects Blu-ray disc structures or `.mkv` files; a single MKV loads its tracks immediately, while folders with multiple MKVs list them in natural order on the left and scan tracks on selection. Video and audio tracks resolve raw extensions automatically, SRT/ASS/SSA/PGS subtitles use matching extensions, and MKV chapters are probed via `ffprobe` and exported as UTF-8 OGG `.txt` files when `eac3to` does not list them. `DGDemux` continues to support Blu-ray folders only.
- Fix garbled non-ASCII track titles and file paths when `eac3to` writes console output in the Windows ANSI code page (such as GBK on Chinese Windows).
- Fix `eac3to` Blu-ray playlist parsing: handle carriage returns and backspace control characters properly, support multi-segment `.m2ts` entries, angle labels, and multi-line chapter summaries, and retry without `-minDuration=0` when no playlists are returned.

### Visual update

- Fix progress bar jumps and stalls during `deew 5.5.2+` pipe encoding and Atmos measure-only runs by mapping active stages continuously across 0%–100% and retaining displayed progress on `percent: null` pulse updates.

Short-sample encoding and loudness measurement passed with deew 5.5.3, and decoded 96 kHz TrueHD PCM matched the source PCM byte for byte (see the [validation record](https://github.com/frankie1024/FlowEncode/blob/v3.0.5/docs/DEEW553-VALIDATION.md)); `eac3to` MKV demuxing, ANSI Chinese track titles, MKV chapter export, and Blu-ray disc scanning passed local manual checks and regression tests. Real TrueHD Atmos measurement, Atmos encoding, and `-wm`/`-bc` decoding on real Atmos media still await media validation.

Windows x64 installer, portable ZIP, and SHA256 checksums are provided.
